cli_desc: Merge several PDFs into one (--merge) or shrink PDFs by re-encoding their images (--shrink). Nothing is uploaded and the originals are never modified. Without inputs the window opens.
cli_merge: merge the inputs in the given order -> <first>_merged.pdf
cli_pages: page range to take when merging, one per input in order, e.g. --pages 1-10 --pages all
cli_no_bookmarks: do not write bookmarks (outline) when merging
cli_quality: image quality: normal(80) small(65) minimum(45), default normal
cli_output: output file path (merging, or shrinking a single file)
cli_help: show this help message and exit
